name: The Hills of Edinburgh
description: The City of Edinburgh famously contains seven hills, all sitting at least 100 metres above sea level. Three of these: Calton Hill (EH7), Arthur's Seat (EH8), and Castle Rock (EH1) can be found within the game area. For this challenge, you must climb to the top of one of these hills and take a team photo at the summit. The summit positions can be found on the in-game map. For Castle Rock (EH1), you need only reach the castle's gatehouse.

name: Film a Duck
description: Edinburgh contains several bodies of water which can host ducks and other wildlife. For this challenge, you must find and film a duck for a number of minutes specified by the sum of two D6 dice rolls. During this time, the duck must remain in-frame but you may change position throughout the recording. If at any point the duck leaves the frame, you must wait 5 minutes before trying again.
